newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: SAirGroup names Jeffrey Katz Swissair CEO.
newsitem.headline: SAirGroup names Jeffrey Katz Swissair CEO.

text.p: SAirGroup said Jeffrey Katz would become chief executive of its Swissair AG airline unit in January 1998.

"Philippe Bruggisser, president and CEO of the SAirGroup, is to hand over operating control of Swissair to Jeffrey Katz, 41, who will take over as Swissair CEO in January 1998," it said in a statement.
It said Katz was joining Swissair from American Airlines AMR.N, where he was in charge of passenger sales in the western United States and president of its SABRE travel information network.
